claim: You can store pre-shared keys in AWS Secrets Manager rather than directly in the Site-to-Site VPN service.
question: Where can a Site-to-Site VPN pre-shared key be stored besides the VPN service itself?

values.display: store pre-shared keys (PSKs) in AWS Secrets Manager
values.spoken: store the pre-shared key in AWS Secrets Manager

values.display: rather than directly in the Site-to-Site VPN service

evidence.quote: A key improvement is the ability to store pre-shared keys (PSKs) in AWS Secrets Manager rather than directly in the Site-to-Site VPN service, allowing for better secret management and compliance with security best practices.
